{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/sh

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./mcmicro.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   --time=2:00:00  -> -t 2h
#   --mem=4G        -> (not translated; see note)
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -t 2h --wrap "sh $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm --partition=cpu-short not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources; you are not forcing the cpu-short partition.

  # NOTE: Slurm -J=mcmicro_SMM_multisample not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: Slurm -o=mcmicro-%J.log uses %J expansion (jobid) which Flux does not provide portably.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: logs may overwrite unless you generate unique filenames.

  # NOTE: Slurm --mem=4G not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed, affecting reliability/performance.

  # NOTE: Slurm --mail-type/--mail-user not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: no email notifications.

  # NOTE: Slurm --chdir ... translated by explicit cd below.

  module purge
  module load nextflow
  module load apptainer

  export NXF_APPTAINER_CACHEDIR="/research/labs/hematology/hemedata/m302618/apptainer/containers"

  cd /research/labs/hematology/hemedata/m302618/projects/spatial/cdx_pipeline_mforge/MCMICRO/ || exit 1

  flux run -n 1 nextflow -C mforge_settings.config run labsyspharm/mcmicro --in 20240112_BR062124_Gonsalves_CD45 -with-report
fi
"
}
